title: Oriented Perovskite Growth Regulation Enables Sensitive Broadband Detection and Imaging of Polarized Photons Covering 300-1050 nm

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Polarization photodetectors need intrinsically anisotropic absorbers with broadband UV-to-NIR response; solution-processed polycrystalline films are usually randomly oriented. Regulating oriented growth of a quasi-2D Sn-Pb perovskite film should give crystal anisotropy for broadband polarized-photon detection.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (PRC/deposition)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Additive-grown films have a preferred out-of-plane orientation, (202) planes parallel to the substrate, layers vertically aligned. Sn and Pb mix into one uniform Pb-Sn perovskite lattice
states.detail: Absorbed: n6 (STR/microstructure/orientation), n7 (STR/chemistry/composition). Premises: Sharp Bragg spots on the qz axis of GIWAXS indicate out-of-plane preferred orientation

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Sn-Pb film absorbs out to ~1000 nm versus ~760 nm for the Pb-only film (Eg 1.24 vs 1.65 eV). Oriented films show absorption linear dichroism: absorbance is higher for 0 deg than 90 deg polarization.
states.detail: Absorbed: n8 (PRP/value), n9 (PRP/value), n10 (MEC/pathway), n12 (MEC/pathway). Premises: In PEA-based layered perovskites PEA...Pb-I layers align MA along a via N-H...I bonds (ref. 29); In crystals with oriented planes, photocarrier migration to the electrodes is confined to designated transport channels (ref. 42)

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Additive-oriented photodiode gives polarization-dependent photocurrent, min/max ~0.43 at 90/270 deg, while no-additive, mesoporous and Si devices are nearly angle-independent. Polarization-sensitive response spans ~300-1050 nm: responsivity at 0 deg is ~1.9x that at 90 deg across the band.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (PRF/service_capability), n13 (PRF/service_capability), n14 (PRF/figure_of_merit), n15 (PRF/service_capability). Premises: D* = (A*delta f)^0.5 * R / noise current (equivalently sqrt(A delta f)/NEP)

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Additive-regulated oriented growth makes solution-processed Sn-Pb quasi-2D films anisotropic, enabling sensitive broadband (300-1050 nm) polarization detection and imaging
